text.title: Graceful Offboard Script Output Contract
text.summary: Draft-07 JSON Schema for the offboard artefact: at least two quantified bad-fit signals from the QBR, the termination clause and last service date, the script's fit framing and banned-phrase check, the per-asset handover inventory, the confirmed alternative provider, live-then-written delivery, the T+30 feedback request and the internal record that changes intake. Validator: `scripts/validate-graceful-offboard-script.py`.

section.title: JSON Schema (draft-07)
section.note: What the schema cannot express and the reviewer checks by hand: `contract.days_notice_given` is at least `contract.notice_days` and `last_service_date` is not before `minimum_term_end` (r-exit-date-honours-termination-clause); every asset the agency holds for the client appears in `handover.assets`, not a sample, and `owned_by = client` assets have `conditioned_on_payment = false` unless a clause is quoted (r-handover-plan-with-asset-inventory); each `alternatives[].confirmed_on` precedes `delivery.live_conversation.date` (r-recommended-alternative-confirmed-first); `feedback_request.scheduled_date` equals `last_service_date + 30` (r-post-offboard-feedback-at-t-plus-30); the `banned_phrases_found` scan was run against the actual script text with the list in r-frame-as-fit-not-confession.

example.note: Subject violations: one bad-fit signal, and the margin signal covers a single quarter (r-bad-fit-evidenced-by-qbr-data); 14 days' notice on a 30-day clause with a prepaid period left unresolved (r-exit-date-honours-termination-clause); an apology framing with two banned phrases and a criticism of the client (r-frame-as-fit-not-confession); the ad account transfer conditioned on payment with no clause and no transition support (r-handover-plan-with-asset-inventory); no alternative provider (r-recommended-alternative-confirmed-first); email-only delivery and a written version five days later that adds new points (r-delivered-live-then-written); feedback on the last service date with an arguing response (r-post-offboard-feedback-at-t-plus-30); and an intake change of "none" not flagged for review (r-root-cause-changes-intake-criteria).

antipattern.description: `script.framing` anything but `fit_and_alignment`, any entry in `banned_phrases_found`, or `client_criticism_found` true.
antipattern.reason: r-frame-as-fit-not-confession: the exit words are the words the client repeats to their network.

antipattern.description: `days_notice_given` below `contract.notice_days`, a last service date before `minimum_term_end`, or a prepaid period with disposition `not_applicable`.
antipattern.reason: r-exit-date-honours-termination-clause: ending early is a breach the client can invoice for.

antipattern.description: A client-owned asset with `conditioned_on_payment` true and no `conditioning_clause_id`, an asset the agency holds missing from the inventory, or `transition_support.days` of 0.
antipattern.reason: r-handover-plan-with-asset-inventory: the handover is where the reputation is won or lost.

antipattern.description: `alternatives` empty, or a provider whose `confirmed_on` is after the live conversation date.
antipattern.reason: r-recommended-alternative-confirmed-first: an unconfirmed name that declines the client makes the agency look careless twice.

antipattern.description: `delivery.email_only` true, no `live_conversation`, `written_follow_up` more than one business day later, or `contains_only_what_was_said` false.
antipattern.reason: r-delivered-live-then-written: an offboard by email is the detail the client remembers.

antipattern.description: `feedback_request` missing, `days_after_last_service` not 30, or a non-promoter action that argues.
antipattern.reason: r-post-offboard-feedback-at-t-plus-30: the last contact is what the ex-client repeats.

antipattern.description: Fewer than two `bad_fit_signals`, a signal without value and target, or a margin signal over fewer than two consecutive quarters.
antipattern.reason: r-bad-fit-evidenced-by-qbr-data: one signal is an intervention, not an exit.
r-root-cause-changes-intake-criteria: the same bad-fit client is signed again next quarter.

text.reference: Stdlib-only validator for this contract; `--self-test` runs both examples above.
Offboard script and handover skeleton with the same sections and field names.
